subject.title: Fork-per-issue from one warmed repo box

question: Should Clownfish support a warmed snapshot-fork workspace backend, and which provider and rollout boundary should become part of the supported architecture?
rationale: The choice changes Clownfish’s operational dependencies, isolation guarantees, credential lifecycle, cache policy, cleanup behavior, portability, and cost; repository evidence does not establish one approved backend or default.

options.title: Prototype behind opt-in
options.body: Define a provider boundary and canary one warmed fork backend while retaining the current checkout path as the default and fallback.

options.title: Keep standard runner caching
options.body: Continue optimizing clone, package-store, and runner caches without adopting snapshot-fork infrastructure.

options.title: Adopt a required backend
options.body: Select Mitos or Crabbox as mandatory workspace infrastructure and design Clownfish around its lease lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Prototype behind opt-in
recommendation.body: Define a provider boundary and canary one warmed fork backend while retaining the current checkout path as the default and fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across the worker checkout, executor, runner-capacity, and parallelism surfaces affected by the decision.
